recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a man in a black cowboy hat and shirt, positioned against a vertical corrugated metal wall. The composition uses high-contrast lighting and a dual-layered typographic system featuring a tall, condensed display font and a wide, futuristic script.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical lines of the background echoing the verticality of the condensed display type
Dark silhouette of the subject against the reflective, bright metallic texture
Contrast between the organic facial features and the rigid industrial geometry
Juxtaposition of tall, thin lettering with short, wide lettering
coreInvariants: Black cowboy hat and black shirt
Two distinct typographic styles with contrasting widths

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, from the waist up, scaled to fill the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the brim of the cowboy hat create the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subject's face down to the large display text, then to the smaller wide script below it.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right third of the frame is dominated by the repetitive pattern of the metal wall.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black (clothing and hat) providing a solid base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Silver/Grey (metallic background) providing texture and light.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White (typography) for maximum legibility against dark and light areas.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall, relying on value contrast (black vs. silver) for impact.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of ultra-condensed sans-serif and ultra-extended geometric script.
letterConstructionRules: Primary text: uniform stroke weight, high aspect ratio, flat terminals.
Secondary text: horizontal emphasis, rounded terminals, connected or semi-connected script.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' in the display font has a high crossbar.
The script font features extremely long horizontal connectors.

composition.relationshipToImage: layered over the chest of the subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme width contrast: pairing a very tall font with a very wide font.
graphicDevices: Subtle drop shadows on text to separate it from the complex background texture.

preserve: The condensed nature of the main name
The extended, tech-like feel of the secondary title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the tall, condensed, clean sans-serif look.
Captures the wide, industrial, geometric feel for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium close-up portrait of a man with a goatee wearing a black cowboy hat and a plain black long-sleeve shirt. He is standing in front of a wall made of vertical corrugated silver metal. The lighting is bright and even, creating a clean industrial look.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main name in a tall, white, condensed sans-serif font across the center. Below it, add the title in a small, white, ultra-extended lowercase script font. Apply a very soft drop shadow to the main name.

verificationChecks: Is the subject wearing a black cowboy hat?
Is there a clear contrast between the tall font and the wide font?
Is the text white and legible against both the black shirt and silver background?

adjustableVariables: Tracking/letter spacing of the display text
Placement of the text (higher or lower on the torso)
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Any specific brand logos on the hat or clothing
Unique decorative elements on the hat band

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp focus on the subject
High value contrast between subject and background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the metal texture looks realistic and reflective.
Check that the cowboy hat does not cast a shadow that obscures the eyes.
Verify the two fonts are distinctly different in width.
Confirm the composition feels balanced with the subject on the left.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Industrial Texture + High-Contrast Lighting + Width-Contrasted Typography
